content.title: Chapter 22 - BUSINESSES — Sec. 22-206. - License denial, suspension, cancellation or revocation.
content.summary:
(a)
A license may be denied, canceled, suspended or revoked by the city clerk for any
               reason set forth in this article.
(b)
An applicant may appeal a denial or a licensee may appeal a cancellation, suspension
               or revocation of a license as provided in
section 2-171
et se…

faqs.q: Sec. 22-206. - License denial, suspension, cancellation or revocation.
faqs.a:
(a)
A license may be denied, canceled, suspended or revoked by the city clerk for any
               reason set forth in this article.
(b)
An applicant may appeal a denial or a licensee may appeal a cancellation, suspension
               or revocation of a license as provided in
section 2-171
et seq.
(Code 1981, § 23-6; Ord. No. 3238, § 1, 12-18-1995)
